title: Egyptian Lamb Tagine in One Pot
description: A twist on traditional Italian cooking, this one-pot dish combines the flavors of Egypt with lamb and wholesome ingredients.

ingredients.name: One Pot
ingredients.notes: large Dutch oven or heavy pot

instructions: Season the lamb shoulder with salt and pepper.
Heat the pot over medium-high heat. Brown the lamb on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Add the onions, garlic, and tagine spice blend to the pot. Cook, stirring occasionally, for 5 minutes.
Add the chopped tomatoes, chicken broth, and lemon juice to the pot. Stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then cover the pot and transfer it to the preheated oven.
Braise the lamb for 2 1/2 hours, or until it is tender and falls apart easily.
Stir in the sliced almonds and chopped parsley. Serve hot over couscous or rice.
Let the dish rest for 10 minutes before serving to allow the flavors to meld.
Serve with crusty bread or over couscous for a filling meal.
